info.name: Fundrise Connect (External API) Tax Forms API

params.name: taxYear
params.description: Tax year in which to search for tax forms.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account ID (returned by the Create Client operation or the Get Client operation) associated with the request.

items.docs: Get the full lists of tax document data available for a specific year for the current authorized Client. The tax document URLs are AWS presigned URLs that are valid for 5 minutes.
